contact_cta.k: Lawn care, cleanups, a new patio?

intro.text: Green Machine Landscaping is a family owned and operated landscaping company in Stony Brook. Owner Jason brings a deep understanding of lawn maintenance, botany and soil science together with a love of design, backed by over 20 years of experience and 38 years as a Three Village resident. From weekly mowing and seasonal cleanups to new plantings, patios and walkways, his crew treats every property like their own.
intro.quote: A Three Village neighbor who treats your yard like his own.

services.d: Weekly cutting through the growing season, edging, trimming and clippings removed for a neat, manicured look.
Leaves cleared from shrubs, beds and lawns, sticks and small branches removed and debris cleaned up.
Shrubs, perennials and trees, plus custom soil, mulch, edging and decorative rock.
Paver patios and walkways, steppers and retaining walls in stone, block or boulders.
Full-service Kentucky bluegrass sod, plus thatch removal, core aeration and overseeding.
Drain tile systems and basins, grading, soil conditioning and removal of old landscaping.

items.h: A neat, manicured lawn all season.
items.d: Weekly cutting (weather permitting), edging and trimming, with clippings removed from the property.
Leaves out of the shrubs and beds, lawns vacuumed of leaves, sticks and small branches picked up and debris cleared.

items.h: Curb appeal from the ground up.
items.d: Old landscaping removed, soil prepared, then new shrubs, perennials and trees with mulch, edging and decorative rock.
Paver patios and walkways in cobblestone, Holland stone or flagstone, plus steppers and retaining walls.
Kentucky bluegrass sod from start to finish, or thatch removal, core aeration and overseeding.
